CBSE • CLASS 10 • SOCIAL SCIENCE

Geography

20 marks. Contemporary India II — resources, water, agriculture, minerals, industry.

  • Ch 5 · Resources and DevelopmentTypes of resources, land use, soil types and conservation.
  • Ch 6 · Water ResourcesScarcity, multi-purpose projects, and rainwater harvesting.
  • Ch 7 · AgricultureCropping patterns, crop requirements and food security.
  • Ch 8 · Minerals and Energy ResourcesMineral belts, conventional and non-conventional energy.
  • Ch 9 · Manufacturing IndustriesClassification, agro-based and mineral-based industries, pollution.
  • Ch 10 · Lifelines of National EconomyRoadways, railways, pipelines, waterways, airways and trade.
  • Always give an Indian example with a name and a state.
